# `gameplay/events/EventGraph.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/events/EventGraph.js`

EventGraph — The event bus and event log for LIFE. Every meaningful thing in the world becomes an event. Events power: memories, dialogue, reputation, crimes, family history, item souls, resolve changes, and storylet triggers. Events are immutable once created. The log is append-only. Listeners can subscribe to event types or use wildcard '*'.

## Functions

### `createEvent(config)`

Creates an immutable event object.

**Parameters:**

- `config` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `config.type` *(string)* — Event type (e.g. 'npc.stole', 'player.born', 'combat.hit')
- `[config.sender]` *(string)* — Entity ID of who caused this event
- `[config.target]` *(string)* — Entity ID of who this event affects
- `[config.data]` *(object)* — Arbitrary payload
- `[config.location]` *(string)* — Where it happened (location ID or coordinates)
- `[config.witnesses]` *(string[])* — Entity IDs of who saw it
- `[config.tags]` *(string[])* — Content tags (hunger, betrayal, family, fear, etc.)
- `[config.description]` *(string)* — Human-readable description

**Returns:** Frozen event object
